description:
A crowdfunded anime short animated by studio GYORAI EIZOU, made for the Kyoto Municipal Transportation Bureau’s subway PR project, Get on! Kyoto City Subway campaign.

It’s about a group of three high school girls who explore Kyoto using the Kyoto City Subway system.

Note: Initially released in May 2017, this anime later got a theatrical release from December 23rd, 2017 to January 5th, 2018. It was then re-released on their official YouTube channel on May 2018.
